intent_scope.goal: Add a one-click join icon to TimedEventCard and AllDayEventCard for events with a conference link.

evidence: packages/web/src/views/Week/components/Event/Grid/GridEvent/GridEvent.tsx:139 passes the whole GridEvent object as event=
packages/web/src/views/Week/components/Grid/AllDayRow/AllDayEvent.tsx:66 passes the whole GridEvent object as event=
conference_plumbing.caveat: Write path deliberately drops it: packages/web/src/events/grid-event-draft.adapter.ts:592 editableContent() picks only title/description/location/color, and the comment at :583-591 says conference is read-only and must not reach the strict write contract. A draft/placeholder card round-tripped through the draft adapter will have no conference - gate the icon on displayMode === 'saved' / !isPlaceholder, matching the existing showRepeatIcon gates.
